title: 🏥 Tarrytown NY Healthcare Jobs with Multiple High-Paying Roles
text:
1 days ago Tarrytown’s healthcare scene is busy right now, from front-line pharmacy to high-level research and clinical leadership. If you’re in medicine or pharma, there are some strong options here worth a look.
Staff Pharmacist – Full Time Employer: CVS Health Location: Tarrytown, NY Type: Full-time (approx. 39 hrs/week) Pay: $65.00 – $81.00/hour Application window closes: 11/25/2026
This role is for a front-line pharmacist in a retail setting, handling safe dispensing, patient counseling, immunizations, and helping lead the pharmacy team. Good fit if you like direct patient contact, steady hours, and a full benefits package (medical, dental, vision, PTO, retirement). Medical Director, Clinical Development – Genetic Medicine (MASH) Employer: Regeneron (posted via BioSpace) Location: Tarrytown, NY Type: Full-time Work model: On-site 4 days/week , ~10% travel Salary range: $284,900 – $385,700/year
Lead clinical development strategy for genetic medicine programs from first-in-human through Phase 3 in MASH/metabolism. Ideal for an M.D. (board-certified/eligible in Hepatology, GI, Endocrinology, or Nephrology) who wants to drive trial design, regulatory strategy, and cross-functional teams in a science-heavy, global impact role.
